section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants in a study examining the temporal stability of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2). The main sample consisted of 840 Brazilian students (438 boys, 402 girls) aged 13-17 years from three cities in São Paulo State, with self-reported BMI data. A second independent sample of 46 students (19 boys, 27 girls) with a lower mean age (14.02 years) completed the BAS-2 twice within a two-week period to assess test-retest reliability.
